oimr.options.host_only_tooltip: Only the Solitary/LAN host or server steward may alter these decrees.
oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Heed this warning: Unbinding slot sharing may verily conjure twin wares (intended design).
Leaving any hotbar or arms slot unbound keepeth each player's wares apart and may verily cause wares to double when players enter, trade fellowships, or move goods. Such is intended stage design.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Foul affinity measure espied in thy ledger (> 100%% or crooked); affinity hath been restored to 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Governs how fiercely draughts, mending, knockback, wounds, and Respiration be shared. At 100%%, all comrades' fates are bound; beneath 100%% sundereth mandatory chain-deaths (e.g. at 50%%, 10 harm unto A dealeth 5 unto comrades). Doth not alter bound satchel slots.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.n: Harm for 1 fellowship heart: naught (0%% affinity)
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Revealeth how much harm one comrade must suffer (2 HP = 1 heart) ere fellows take 1 full heart (2 HP) o' shared wounds.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Per-player hunger exhaustion measure: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Per-player experience gain measure: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. Spending XP (enchantments, anvil) remaineth unchanged.
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: When ON, all 9 hotbar slots (including thy main hand) are shared amongst the fellowship.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.tooltip: When Hotbar binding be OFF, bindeth Hotbar Slot 1 as a shared main-hand slot.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.coupled_too: Governed by Bind Hotbar whilst Hotbar binding be ON (main hand useth the chosen hotbar slot).
oimr.settings.sync_off_hand.tooltip: Bindeth the offhand slot across fellowship comrades.
oimr.settings.sync_helmet.tooltip: Bindeth the helm armour slot across fellowship comrades.
oimr.settings.sync_chestplate.tooltip: Bindeth the breastplate armour slot across fellowship comrades.
oimr.settings.sync_leggings.tooltip: Bindeth the greaves armour slot across fellowship comrades.
oimr.settings.sync_boots.tooltip: Bindeth the boots armour slot across fellowship comrades.
oimr.settings.shared_knockback.tooltip: Carrieth knockback across the fellowship (measured by Affinity) and dealeth backward recoil when striking a comrade.
oimr.settings.friendly_pets.tooltip: Forbiddeth tamed or trusted beasts o' fellowship comrades from assailing their brethren.
oimr.settings.exclude_creative.tooltip: When ON, comrades in Omnipotence State be not slain by 100%% Affinity cascade demise.
oimr.settings.wipe_creative.tooltip: When Omnipotence State comrades outlive cascade demise, still clear shared satchel, arms, and XP.
oimr.settings.comunism.tooltip: Proclaimeth a mirthful common-wealth jest when the fellowship wasteth away from hunger.
oimr.settings.shared_ender_pearl.tooltip: Spiriteth the entire fellowship to the landing spot whene'er any comrade casteth an Ender Pearl.
oimr.settings.shared_portals.tooltip: Conveyeth the entire fellowship together whene'er any comrade passeth through a Nether or End Portal.
oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Casteth an aquatic muffled veil o'er sounds whene'er thou or a bound comrade be beneath the waves.
oimr.settings.shared_mob_sounds.tooltip: Echoeth creature cries heard by comrades with 1/N chance (N = fellowship size), true bearing toward the beast, matched distance, and loudness measured by Affinity.
